scripts.build:libs: npm run build -w @lattice/otel && npm run build -w @lattice/logger && npm run build -w @lattice/queue && npm run build -w @lattice/jwt && npm run build -w @lattice/prisma-client && npm run build -w @lattice/ml && npm run build -w @lattice/ioredis && npm run build -w @lattice/capability-validation
scripts.test:e2e:up: docker compose -f compose.test.yaml --env-file .env.test up -d postgres rabbitmq emqx cache && docker compose -f compose.test.yaml --env-file .env.test run --rm migrate && docker compose -f compose.test.yaml --env-file .env.test up -d
scripts.test:e2e:hard-restart: docker compose -f compose.test.yaml --env-file .env.test down -v && docker compose -f compose.test.yaml --env-file .env.test up -d && docker compose run --rm migrate
scripts.dev:hard-restart: docker compose -f compose.yaml -f compose.dev.yaml down -v && docker compose -f compose.yaml -f compose.dev.yaml up -d --build --force-recreate && docker compose run --rm migrate
